items.description: Released DE Levi Onwuzurike. Released DL Tyre West from the practice squad.
Released WR Bo Melton and signed him to the practice squad.
Claimed G Atonio Mafi off waivers from Las Vegas. Waived G Garrett Dellinger.
Released OT D.J. Humphries.
Placed DT Kayden McDonald on injured reserve. Signed DT Jaden Crumedy to the active roster.
Signed DB Anthony Johnson to the practice squad.
Signed WR Tom Kennedy to the active roster. Signed DB Natrone Brooks to the practice squad.
Signed CB Jaylon Jones to the active roster. Waived CB Melvin Smith.
Elevated S Tanner Ingle from the practice squad.
Released TE Ben Sims from injured reserve with a settlement.
Signed WR Gary Jennings to the practice squad. Released DB Isas Waxter from the practice squad.
Placed DT Alfred Collins on injured reserve. Elevated WR KhaDarel Hodge and DL Ogbo Okoronkwo from the practice squad.
Signed DT Zacch Pickens to the practice squad.
Signed DB Keidron Smith to the practice squad. Released DB Beanie Bishop from the suspended list with an injury settlement.
Placed G Tyler Smith on reserve/injured-designated for return. Signed G Nick Leverett from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed G Laken Tomlinson to the practice squad.

Signed OLB Jihad Ward to the practice squad.
Elevated RB Lan Larison and P Mitch Wishnowsky from the practice squad to the active roster.

Waived LB Curtis Jacobs, WR Jacoby Jones and TE Quentin Moore from injured reserve with injury settlements.
Signed OLB Jeremiah Moon to the practice squad. Released OLB Cam Gill from the practice squad.
Released DB Darren Hall from injured reserve with an injury settlement.
Signed WR Bub Means and DE Nadame Tucker to the practice squad. Released WR Bryce Oliver and P Wes Pahl from the practice squad.
